front.title: Comparable Sequence Numbers Across Publishers in YANG Datastore Telemetry

abstract.t: In YANG Push version 2, each publisher numbers its own notifications, and the numbers of two publishers are not comparable. When data moves from one publisher to another, a receiver cannot tell from the sequence numbers which update is newer. This document proposes carrying a Hybrid Logical Clock (HLC), a timestamp plus a small tie-breaking counter, in the notification envelope. It gives one order across publishers with constant state at the receiver and does not wrap in practice.
